name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab
tagline: SPACER TAB FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab is an accessory used on top of adjustable pedestals to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of pavers in raised flooring systems. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has four breakable tabs to support four paver corners that rest on top of the adjustable pedestal. SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Spacer Tab is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® K and may be manufactured with tabs of various thicknesses to create varying drainage gaps sizes, to support concrete pavers, stone pavers, and porcelain tiles that have a minimum thickness of 20 mm.
